title: Pew: Google users and AI-summary clicks
published_or_version: July 22, 2025; March browsing, April result reconstruction
method: Observed browsing from 900 US adults; 68,879 unique searches.
limitations: Queries were not randomized. Search results were reconstructed later and could differ from what the user originally saw.

title: Adobe: Q2 2026 AI-sourced traffic insights
method: Adobe Analytics observations; separate consumer survey.
limitations: Customer-site coverage, referral attribution and user intent affect comparisons. Retail findings do not measure autonomous checkout volume.

title: Shopify: how agentic commerce works
method: Platform-reported traffic, order growth and deployment status.
limitations: No absolute denominator supplied for the growth claims. AI-sourced orders include human-completed checkouts.

title: Google: agentic-commerce launch and UCP
limitations: Initial eligible-merchant rollout and forward-looking availability; not independent adoption or transaction data.

title: Google: UCP updates
limitations: Cart, catalog and identity capabilities establish technical scope, not usage or commercial outcomes.

title: Google Developers: under the hood of UCP
method: Primary protocol explanation and reference implementation.
limitations: Illustrative integration; interoperability and merchant participation must be checked for a particular deployment.

title: Walmart and Google: shopping in Gemini
method: Retailer announcement of a planned experience.
limitations: Does not disclose transaction volume, conversion lift or the resulting split of customer economics.

title: Visa: completed agent-initiated transactions
limitations: Hundreds of completed transactions establish feasibility, not mass adoption, independent fraud performance or long-run unit economics.

title: Visa Intelligent Commerce: developer capabilities
limitations: Available functions and consent controls do not show usage or guarantee prevention of fraud and disputes.

title: Cloudflare: measuring crawl-to-referral ratios
limitations: Cloudflare-covered sites; HTML requests and identifiable referer headers. Crawling is neither a citation nor a sale.

title: Google Search Central: AI features and websites
method: Primary guidance on search eligibility and measurement.
limitations: No special AI markup requirement does not mean ranking is predictable; visibility remains platform-dependent.
